headers.name: x-sucuri-id
headers.source: https://docs.sucuri.net/website-firewall/sucuri-cdn/ (the PoP of the Sucuri CDN that answered, its first two digits naming the data center), and observed on 2026-11-16 on sucuri.net and on webhosting.net, a customer named by Sucuri (https://sucuri.net/customers/webhosting/)

headers.name: x-sucuri-cache
headers.source: https://docs.sucuri.net/website-firewall/sucuri-cdn/ (tells whether the page was served straight from the Sucuri CDN), and observed on 2026-11-16 on sucuri.net and webhosting.net (HIT and MISS)

cookies.name: sucuri_cloudproxy_uuid_*
cookies.source: https://docs.sucuri.net/warnings/hardening/cookies-httponly/ (cookie of the firewall itself, created by the JavaScript of its bot challenge when a visitor passes it)

cookies.name: sucuricp_tf_*
cookies.source: https://docs.sucuri.net/warnings/hardening/cookies-httponly/ (cookie of the firewall itself, set when a visitor passes a Protected Page or captcha)

cookies.name: sucuricp_tfga_*
cookies.source: https://docs.sucuri.net/warnings/hardening/cookies-httponly/ (cookie of the firewall itself, set when a visitor passes a Protected Page or captcha)

cookies.name: sucuricp_tfca_*
cookies.source: https://docs.sucuri.net/warnings/hardening/cookies-httponly/ (cookie of the firewall itself, set when a visitor passes a Protected Page or captcha)

cookies.name: sucuric_prtmpcb
cookies.source: https://docs.sucuri.net/warnings/hardening/cookies-httponly/ (cookie of the firewall itself, set when a WordPress admin submits a form in /wp-admin/, to bypass the cache for 10 minutes)

server.source: https://docs.sucuri.net/website-firewall/sucuri-cdn/ and https://docs.sucuri.net/website-firewall/troubleshooting/investigating-cache-headers/ (example responses), and observed on 2026-11-16 on sucuri.net and webhosting.net
